correctness.rationale: Formal 2-adic factor cancellation turns the signed cubic partition series into a distinct-weight subset generating product. Exhaustive exact bitset recurrence covers every index 124..373 using ten specified weights and enumerates all 23 missing indices below 124 using the eight smaller weights. Adding the allowable weight 250 extends coverage to 623; successive odd cubes from 343 extend it indefinitely by a proved positive overlap margin 2v^3-(v+2)^3 for v>=9. Two independent algorithms agree for coefficients 0..2048. Finite experiments are only supporting checks; no unproved infinite computation is relied on.

value.rationale: The sharp cutoff for the first nontrivial odd exponent is a natural exact invariant left unspecified by the general 2020 partition-inequality theorem. Establishing the full equality set and proving no later equalities converts ineffective eventual positivity and finite tables into an unconditional optimal boundary. The cubic digit-weight mechanism requires its own finite certificate and infinite overlap proof; the statement is neither a restatement of generic nonnegativity nor a known-table recomputation.
